headline: Sensex and Nifty trade flat near 23,000 as high oil prices and bond yield fluctuations weigh on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Brent crude prices rising towards $106 per barrel impacting energy-sensitive sectors
Indian 10-year bond yields hitting 4-month lows following a US debt rout
Volatility in IT and midcap stocks offsetting gains in other sectors
Recent sharp market correction where the Sensex lost over 3,000 points since the GDP announcement
whatHappening: Nifty 50 is trading range-bound near the 23,000 mark after a volatile start
Dabur India has received NCLT approval for its merger with Ayurvedic brand Sesa Care
Vascon Engineering has been awarded a significant ₹660 crore contract by Qualcomm India
NSE Chairman Ashish Chauhan has hinted at the possibility of the exchange self-listing on its own platform
summary: The Indian stock market is trading range-bound with the Nifty 50 hovering near 23,000 amid headwinds from high oil prices and bond yield volatility. Corporate news is dominated by Dabur's merger approval and Vascon Engineering's major order win. Investors are also closely watching the NSE for potential self-listing developments following hints from its chairman.
